profile.name: SASHL
profile.title: Full Stack .NET Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack .NET Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise web solutions. Skilled in C#, ASP.NET, React, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures, with a focus on reliable integrations, maintainable code, and automated testing.

projects.name: Marketplace CDiscount Powered by Octopia
projects.description: A CDiscount subsidiary providing a turnkey e-commerce marketplace to sellers, with access to many services that ease e-commerce growth in France and internationally.
features: Built the registered sales channels module.
Enabled sellers to register on multiple sales channels.
Synchronized seller shops and subscriptions.
Synchronized offers, products, orders and discussions.
Synchronized financial flows (financial reports).
Replicated sales channel catalogs and implemented fine-grained seller catalog management.
tasks: Consumed web services developed by other teams.

projects.name: BIG BOARD
projects.description: Design and development of a platform routing stock-market orders and SICAV investment orders at branch level and for the DGMC front office (Securities and Capital Management Department).
features: Built the administration module (users, roles, permissions).
Built the online trading module.
Built the SICAV (open-ended investment company) module.
Generated PDF files for stock and SICAV orders, and daily trading reports.
tasks: Applied the Repository Pattern to abstract data access, within a layered architecture.

projects.name: Hermes
projects.description: Rebuild of the teletransmission management platform for the international network.
features: Built the administration module (users, roles, permissions).
Built the bank reference data module.
Built the module managing the international message teletransmission network (SWIFT).
Implemented the Message-Text (MT) standard: rule-based message creation, sending, receiving and assignment of SWIFT-MT messages.
tasks: Applied the Repository Pattern to abstract data access, within a layered architecture.
Built batches (Windows services) to automate message transmission.

projects.name: Recruitment Platform
projects.description: Design and implementation of a recruitment platform: job offer management, application management and CV management.
features: Created recruitment needs and produced matching job offers.
Received CVs for each offer.
Filtered CVs by skills and offer requirements.
Scheduled interviews through the platform.
Conducted interviews through the platform.
tasks: Organized the code in layers (layered architecture).
Applied the Repository and Unit of Work patterns.
Built the RESTful web service and wrote the required unit tests.

projects.name: Commercial Offer Automation
projects.description: Design and development of an application that generates a commercial offer document from the description of an IT project (website or mobile app).
features: Detected similarities in structure and content against the current project.
Automatically produced a draft quote.
Built an interface for the project manager to update the quote.
